name: 1Password
summary: 1Password lets agents use stored logins without seeing them: the agent requests a credential, a person approves, and the 1Password extension fills it straight into the page. It started with Browserbase in October 2025 and reached Claude on Mac in July 2026.
facts: Human approval per request by default (biometric on Mac)
Browserbase, Claude (Mac), others announced with Unified Access
goodFor: Browser agents that need to sign in to sites
Keeping passwords out of model context and logs
watchOut: Doesn't protect what the agent does after login
Claude integration is Mac-only at launch
